definitions: The female ruler of an independent state, especially one who inherits the position by right of birth.
The wife or widow of a king.
A woman or thing regarded as the finest or most important in a particular sphere or group.
The most powerful chess piece, able to move any number of squares vertically, horizontally, or diagonally.
A playing card with a picture of a queen on it, ranking above a knave and below a king.
A fully developed fertile female in a colony of social insects, such as bees, ants, or termites, responsible for laying all the eggs.
examples: Queen Elizabeth II reigned for many decades.
The queen consort attended the ceremony.
She was the queen of pop.
He moved his queen to take the rook.
I drew the queen of hearts.
The queen bee is essential for the hive's survival.
